items.html: However, know that even so, there remained mingled within them some very small sparks of holiness, which are the secret of the eleven spices of the incense, as their matter is explained in its place; and they are still destined to be sorted completely, and those sparks of holiness will come out from within them in the future, as is explained by us on the verse "He will swallow up death forever." And behold, this matter was explained in general.
